import sys,json,tempfile,urllib.request,hashlib,platform
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from scripts import validate_neutts_apt_python as v
from pip._internal.operations import check
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
manifest=v.load_manifest(Path("scripts/neutts_apt_python_metadata.json"))
pins=manifest["runtime"]["archives"]+[r["apt"] for r in manifest["apt_distributions"]]
def verify(pin,directory):
    url="https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main/"+pin["repository_path"]
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20) as stream: raw=stream.read(pin["bytes"]+1)
    path=directory/pin["filename"];path.write_bytes(raw)
    wanted={f["path"] for f in manifest["runtime"]["files"] if f["package"]==pin["package"]}
    for row in manifest["apt_distributions"]:
        if row["apt"]["package"]==pin["package"]:
            wanted.update((row["metadata"]["path"],row["wheel"]["path"]))
    data=v.inspect_archive(path,pin,wanted,include_pip=pin["package"]=="python-pip")
    frozen=manifest["runtime"]["files"]+[f for row in manifest["apt_distributions"] for f in (row["metadata"],row["wheel"])]
    for item in frozen:
        if item["path"] in data:
            assert hashlib.sha256(data[item["path"]]).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
            assert "bytes" not in item or len(data[item["path"]])==item["bytes"]
    return {"package":pin["package"],"version":pin["version"],"archive_bytes":len(raw),"archive_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"verified_selected_members":len(data),"verified_frozen_members":len(wanted)}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hermes-neutts-apt-readonly-") as tmp:
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        rows=list(pool.map(lambda pin:verify(pin,Path(tmp)),pins))
print(json.dumps({"purpose":"Host read-only verification of original pinned APT archive contents; no native/install claim","archives":rows,"host_python":sys.executable,"host_version":platform.python_version(),"host_platform":sys.platform,"host_pip_check_source":str(Path(check.__file__).resolve()),"host_pip_check_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(check.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False))
